description: Takes the list of an expert's files (name or path, date, size, owner; for example an export of a folder listing, thousands of rows are fine) and an optional owner name. Sorts every file by keywords in its name and path into ten handover folders (contracts, suppliers, offers and tenders, orders, invoices, processes and instructions, minutes, presentations, reports and lists, other), writes a knowledge card per folder with the newest files and the three questions to answer at handover, finds several versions of the same file (v1, final, copy) with the one to keep, counts files older than three years and the ones that cannot be assigned, and returns a handover index. Only the names are used, the files themselves are not read. To turn a recorded explanation into instructions use build_guide_from_recording. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

as_of.description: Optional: reference date YYYY-MM-DD. Default today (Europe/Berlin).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

owner.description: Optional: whose knowledge this is, for the heading.

rows.description: One row per file: path (or name), date, size, owner. German column names work too (pfad, datei, datum, groesse, besitzer).

name: build_knowledge_package
title: Knowledge transfer package: a file list becomes a folder structure, knowledge cards, a version clean-up list and a handover index
